Title: Document completed Global Search POC baseline for SPACE integration
Description:
Capture what is already live in the Global Search POC so SPACE integration does not re-do that work.

Already done:
- Multi-source search (BuildTrack, Assets, Space Action + sibling Space DBs)
- Azure AI Search as discovery layer; SQL as source of truth; Top-K + LLM answers
- Space Action schema-aware indexing (action.* tables, text columns only; excluded OfflineSyncLog / Synonyms_Configuration; ~6.6k docs in space-action-index)
- Production flags: hydrate from SQL, catalog, incremental sync, security trim, metrics
- Space ProjectId cross-DB hops (Project, HSE, Incident, LMS, CMS, Dashboard)
- SearchBar types + Linked badge for related Space records
- APIs: POST /api/search/results, POST /api/search/answer, GET /api/search/sources
- Widget client under frontend/lib/global-search (createSearchClient)

Deliverable: 1-page baseline note for SPACE app team (architecture, sources, APIs).

Title: Agree SPACE embed strategy: widget vs iframe vs shared package
Description:
Workshop with SPACE application team to pick how Global Search Bar is hosted.

Decide:
- Embed SearchBar in SPACE header (shared React) vs iframe vs copy of lib/global-search
- Auth: reuse SPACE session / SSO vs pass JWT to Global Search API
- API base URL, CORS, DEV vs UAT vs PROD
- Which Space SQL databases must be on for go-live (Action, Project, HSE, etc.)

Deliverable: short integration design (embed choice, auth, env matrix).

Title: Freeze Global Search API contract for SPACE host app
Description:
Publish a stable contract SPACE can call without depending on BuildTrack UI.

Include:
- POST /api/search/results (fast hits, no LLM)
- POST /api/search/answer (Top-K + AI summary)
- GET /api/search/sources
- Request fields: query, filter_type, top_k, source_ids
- Response fields: results[], metadata.database_id, content_type, url, score
- Auth header (Bearer) and 401/422/503 behaviour

Deliverable: API contract page + example payloads SPACE can implement against.

Title: Package SearchBar as reusable module with SPACE-ready props
Description:
Extract frontend/lib/global-search so SPACE can mount it without forking BuildTrack.

Props/config:
- apiBaseUrl, getAuthToken, theme tokens (SPACE colours)
- contentTypes map (project, event, HSE, incident, document, etc.)
- onOpenResult callback for SPACE routing
- source_ids default for SPACE-only search

Deliverable: reusable SearchBar module + README for SPACE developers.

Title: Map SPACE session user into search security and project scope
Description:
Wire SPACE logged-in user into Global Search so results respect SPACE permissions.

Work:
- Pass SPACE JWT/session token to GET/POST /api/search/*
- Map user id / roles to search security_trim (project membership)
- Pass active SPACE project/company as filter so queries are scoped
- Fail closed on missing token; document empty vs forbidden states

Deliverable: auth mapping table + working DEV login from SPACE shell.

Title: Mount Global Search Bar in SPACE application shell (DEV)
Description:
Embed Global Search Bar in SPACE header/shell on DEV.

Work:

- Match SPACE visual tokens where required
- Point to Global Search API DEV (Space SQL via VPN / on-prem)

Description:
Clicking a search result must open the correct SPACE screen, not BuildTrack routes.

Map hit types to SPACE URLs, including:
- space-project / project ? SPACE project page
- event / event_agenda / event_task ? SPACE Action/event screens
- HSE occupational/environmental review ? SPACE HSE
- incident ? SPACE Incident
- employment / LMS ? SPACE LMS
- contract / CMS ? SPACE CMS
- documents / DMS / attachment ? SPACE DMS where keys exist

Deliverable: url mapper + verified clicks for top content types.

Title: Harden Space ProjectId / DocumentId hops for SPACE demo queries
Description:
POC already hops ProjectId across Project, HSE, Incident, LMS, CMS, Dashboard. For SPACE integration, lock demo queries and fill remaining high-value hops.

Work:
- Regression pack: list active projects, HSE reviews, incidents, contracts, EVT/agenda
- Add DocumentId hop (DMS/Attachment ? project) where FKs exist
- Reduce duplicate schema_sql vs space_project cards in UI
- Document which of 17 Space DBs are searchable vs hop-only

Deliverable: demo query list + expected Linked badges.

Title: Deploy Global Search API for SPACE DEV with runbook
Description:
Stand up Global Search API for SPACE DEV (and note UAT path).

Work:
- Env: Space SQL URLs, Azure AI Search indexes, Azure OpenAI, CORS for SPACE origin
- Schema catalog / space-index sync runbook (POST /api/search/space-index)
- Health: /api/health, /api/search/space-index/status, /api/search/sources
- Secrets: Key Vault or equivalent; no keys in SPACE frontend
- One-process-per-port notes (avoid duplicate uvicorn on 8000)

Deliverable: DEV deploy + 1-page runbook for SPACE ops.
